note: A small, hand-curated bank of previous-year UPSC Prelims questions. Questions are paraphrased, not reproduced verbatim; every entry is reviewable and carries the paper and year so a reader can check it against the official paper. Matching is conservative: a story only earns a badge when its own keywords overlap a question's distinctive terms and the topic agrees.

questions.question: The Global Competitiveness Report is published by which organisation?
questions.explanation: The World Economic Forum publishes the Global Competitiveness Report. The IMF publishes the Global Financial Stability Report and the World Bank publishes Doing Business and World Development Report.

questions.question: 'Global Financial Stability Report' is prepared by which institution?
questions.explanation: The Global Financial Stability Report is a biannual IMF publication that assesses global financial stability and vulnerabilities.

questions.question: The term 'Base Erosion and Profit Shifting' is sometimes seen in the news in the context of
options: Shifting of base camps of security forces
questions.explanation: BEPS refers to tax-planning strategies that shift profits to low-tax jurisdictions. The OECD/G20 Inclusive Framework coordinates the response, including the two-pillar global minimum tax.

questions.question: Siachen Glacier is situated to the
questions.explanation: The Siachen Glacier lies in the eastern Karakoram, north of the Line of Control and east of the Aksai Chin region.

questions.question: The 'Miyawaki method' is associated with
questions.explanation: The Miyawaki method is a Japanese technique for planting dense, native, fast-growing mini-forests, widely used in urban afforestation.

questions.question: With reference to the National Green Tribunal, which statements are correct? 1. It is a statutory body. 2. It hears environmental disputes. 3. It is bound by the procedure laid down in the Code of Civil Procedure.
questions.explanation: The NGT was created by the National Green Tribunal Act, 2010. It is not bound by the CPC; it follows principles of natural justice and its own procedure.

questions.question: Which one of the following statements best reflects the relationship between law and liberty?
options: If there are more laws, there is less liberty
If there are no laws, there is no liberty
If there is liberty, laws have to be made by the people
If laws are changed too often, liberty is in danger
questions.explanation: Liberty is not the absence of law but a condition created and protected by law. Without law there is no enforceable sphere of liberty, only the will of the stronger.

questions.question: Which of the following are envisaged by the Right against Exploitation in the Constitution? 1. Prohibition of traffic in human beings and forced labour. 2. Abolition of untouchability. 3. Protection of the interests of minorities.
questions.explanation: Articles 23 and 24 cover trafficking, forced labour and child labour. Untouchability is abolished by Article 17, and minority interests are protected by Articles 29 and 30; both sit outside the Right against Exploitation.

questions.question: The 'Vaccine Vial Monitor' is used to
options: Measure the potency of a vaccine batch in a laboratory
Indicate whether a vaccine vial has been exposed to heat
Track the cold-chain vehicle carrying vaccines
Record the number of doses drawn from a vial
questions.explanation: A Vaccine Vial Monitor is a heat-sensitive label on a vaccine vial. It changes colour cumulatively with heat exposure and tells the health worker whether the vial can still be used.

questions.question: The 'Global Burden of Disease' study is published by
options: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation
questions.explanation: The Global Burden of Disease study is coordinated by the Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation at the University of Washington, in collaboration with WHO and others.

questions.question: With reference to the Exclusive Economic Zone under UNCLOS, which statements are correct? 1. It extends up to 200 nautical miles from the baseline. 2. The coastal state has sovereign rights over the exploration and use of natural resources there.
questions.explanation: Under UNCLOS Part V the EEZ extends up to 200 nautical miles. The coastal state has sovereign rights for exploring, exploiting, conserving and managing natural resources, but not full territorial sovereignty.

questions.question: Which of the following are aims of the Digital India plan? 1. Digital infrastructure as a utility to every citizen. 2. Governance and services on demand. 3. Digital empowerment of citizens.
questions.explanation: Digital India rests on three pillars: digital infrastructure as a core utility, governance and services on demand, and digital empowerment of citizens.
